Viduraadvisors: Saitharun
Key Takeaways
The team discussed the need to update the financial records in Zoho to get a clear view of pending invoices and ensure accurate GST filing.
There was a conversation about transitioning to a new payroll system using Zoho, with a focus on integrating past data and ensuring all payroll details are up-to-date.
The importance of deducting TDS on rental payments was highlighted, with a plan to address any discrepancies with the landlord and ensure compliance.
The team is considering using Razorpay or Paypal for international transactions to avoid high conversion charges, with a focus on integrating a payment gateway for their SaaS product.
A recurring weekly meeting was proposed to ensure all tasks are tracked and completed, with a focus on launching a new product and maintaining compliance.

Financial Updates and Reconciliation
Errors in December revenue figures, pending reconciliation all financial transactions. Lack of clarity on pending invoices, receivables.
Updates on financials April to December, focusing on accrual accounting, closing financials. Transition to Zoho for comprehensive accounting, invoice management underway.
Ensure financial updates complete by next week with detailed review. Transition accounting, invoicing to Zoho for better financial tracking, management.
TDS Compliance and Payment Management
Ensure TDS compliance, update accounting systems, and handle payments through Zoho for accuracy and ease. Implement weekly payment calendar manage pending payments efficiently.
Issues with TDS deductions on rent payments, including mismanagement of accrual entries, potential non-compliance with recent amendments.
Addressing TDS compliance for rent, other payments, including managing bulk uploads, ensuring tax deductions are correctly handled.
New Office Setup in Andhra Pradesh
Explore local incentives, finalize office location, ensure all regulatory requirements, such as GST registration, met for new branch operations.
Need for GST registration and compliance with local regulations, as well as potential strategic advantages of locating in incentive-friendly areas.
Plans for new office Andhra Pradesh, including considerations local incentives, GST registrations, compliance requirements.
GST Reconciliation and Compliance
Potential overpayment of GST due to discrepancies in invoicing and reporting. Reconciliation of GST payments from October onwards needed.
Complete GST reconciliation next week, ensuring all invoices accurately reported, payments correctly made.
Ongoing GST reconciliation, ensuring alignment with invoicing. Efforts underway to complete pending tasks and avoid overpayments.
Shop and Establishment Registration
Requirement for shop and establishment registration in Karnataka, including compliance for co-working spaces to meet local regulatory demands.
Lack of registration may lead to compliance issues, especially given Karnataka's strict enforcement policies.
Obtain necessary registrations to ensure compliance, avoid potential legal issues, especially with office moves or changes in operations.
Weekly Meetings and Coordination
Implementation of weekly meetings for task tracking, coordination, ensuring alignment on priorities, and facilitating better communication.
Set up weekly meetings for better alignment, coordination on priorities, with recurring calendar invites to ensure consistent participation, follow-through.
Lack of structured meetings led to inconsistencies in task tracking, prioritization of essential activities, impacting operational efficiency.
Payment Gateway Integration
Evaluate best option for payment gateway integration that complies with Indian regulations and is user-friendly for international clients. Consideration of Razorpay, PayPal, Stripe for suitability.
High charges, conversion costs with current payment methods, leading to inefficiencies in handling international payments.
Exploring options like PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay for SaaS product payments to ensure smooth international transactions, reduce conversion costs.
International Transaction Optimization
High conversion charges affecting international transactions, leading to increased costs for both company and clients.
Optimize international transaction processes to reduce conversion charges, ensure compliance with international payment regulations.
Explore options like Razorpay, Skydoo for better international payment processing. Aim for seamless integration to support SaaS product launches globally.
Pain Point
Difficulty encountered in creating a user ID and password for professional tax registration, seeking clarification from department officials.
If the landlord does not agree to deduct 10 percent from the professional expenses, the team will have to cover the cost out of pocket.
Expresses understanding of the situation but finds it tedious to assume the responsibility of getting the tedious task of reviewing all the books quickly.
Moving the registered office is not feasible due to the cumbersome procedure involved.
Receiving funds directly to the bank is much more comfortable than routing them through Paypal or Stripe.
The team is currently not effectively managing their priorities and tasks, leading to a lack of progress and being behind schedule.
